79Bike.metaDescription: Shop the 79Bike Falcon Pro electric dirt bike at Umbra Electric — price, specs, financing and worldwide shipping on this Sur-Ron alternative.
79Bike.seoIntro: 79Bike builds a lean, value-focused electric dirt bike aimed squarely at riders comparing Sur-Ron alternatives without cutting corners on power delivery. The Falcon Pro is the model to know here — check its price, specs and top speed against the segment leaders before you decide. Financing and worldwide shipping are available on every 79Bike electric dirt bike we carry.

Altis.metaDescription: Shop the Altis Sigma electric dirt bike at Umbra Electric — price, specs, financing and worldwide shipping.
Altis.seoIntro: Altis keeps its electric dirt bike lineup focused on one machine done well: the Sigma. It's built for riders who want proven Sur-Ron-style performance — instant torque, near-silent trails — without paying flagship prices. Compare the Altis Sigma's price, specs and top speed here, with financing and worldwide shipping included.

Aventon.metaDescription: Shop Aventon electric bikes at Umbra Electric — 7 curated commuter, fat tire, folding and kids models, financing and worldwide shipping.
Aventon.seoIntro: Aventon spans four of our categories — electric commuter, fat tire, folding and kids models — built around dependable range and a clean, reliable ride rather than gimmicks. The Pace 500.3, Level 3, Soltera.2, Aventure.2 fat tire and Sinch.2 folding are the names riders compare most often against Rad Power Bikes and Lectric XP 3.0. Every Aventon electric bike here ships with financing and worldwide delivery.

Bonnell.metaDescription: Shop the Bonnell 775 MX electric dirt bike at Umbra Electric — price, specs, financing and worldwide shipping.
Bonnell.seoIntro: Bonnell's 775 MX is a mid-flagship electric dirt bike built for riders who've outgrown entry-level power but aren't ready for a $10K+ machine. See how its price, specs and top speed stack up against Sur-Ron before you buy — financing and worldwide shipping are available on every order.

Cannondale.metaDescription: Shop Cannondale electric mountain, gravel and kids bikes at Umbra Electric — 7 curated models, financing and worldwide shipping.
Cannondale.seoIntro: Cannondale's electric lineup here spans full-suspension eMTBs (the Moterra Neo range), the Topstone Neo electric gravel bike, the Synapse Neo Carbon electric road bike and the Trail Neo Jr. for younger riders. The Moterra Neo Carbon is the one riders most often compare against Trek Rail and Giant Trance X E+, while the Topstone Neo goes head-to-head with Trek Checkpoint+ on the gravel side. Financing and worldwide shipping are available across the range.

E Ride Pro.metaDescription: Shop E Ride Pro electric dirt bikes at Umbra Electric — SR and SS 2.0 models, price, specs, financing and worldwide shipping.
E Ride Pro.seoIntro: E Ride Pro's SR and SS 2.0 are built to go toe-to-toe with Sur-Ron and Talaria on power and ride feel at a sharper price point. Compare specs, top speed and range across both electric dirt bike models here, with financing and worldwide shipping included on every order.

EMORTAL.metaDescription: Shop EMORTAL Rogue MX-01 electric dirt and fat tire bikes at Umbra Electric — price, specs, financing and worldwide shipping.
EMORTAL.seoIntro: EMORTAL's Rogue MX-01 comes in a standard electric dirt bike build and a fat tire off-road variant, both aimed at riders comparing entry-flagship options against Sur-Ron. Check price, specs and top speed on either version, with financing and worldwide shipping available.

Electric Bike Company.metaDescription: Shop Electric Bike Company cruiser e-bikes at Umbra Electric — Model C, R and S, price, specs, financing and worldwide shipping.
Electric Bike Company.seoIntro: Electric Bike Company builds a classic electric cruiser bike lineup — the Model C, Model R and Model S — for riders who want beach-cruiser style with real commuter range, often cross-shopped against Rad Power Bikes and Aventon. Compare pricing and specs across all three, with financing and worldwide shipping on every order.

Electro & Co.metaDescription: Shop the Electro & Co ETM RTR electric pit bike at Umbra Electric — price, specs, financing and worldwide shipping.
Electro & Co.seoIntro: Electro & Co's ETM RTR is an electric pit bike built for tight trails and technical riding rather than top-speed bragging rights, priced well below Sur-Ron for riders who want a genuinely capable second bike. See specs, price and financing options here, with worldwide shipping included.

GASGAS.metaDescription: Shop the GASGAS MC-E 5 kids electric dirt bike (ages 4-10) at Umbra Electric — price, specs, financing and worldwide shipping.
GASGAS.seoIntro: GASGAS brings its motocross pedigree to the MC-E 5, a kids electric dirt bike built for ages 4-10 with adjustable, parent-limitable power — a direct alternative to the KTM SX-E 5. Compare price and specs here, with financing and worldwide shipping available.

Giant.metaDescription: Shop Giant electric mountain, gravel and kids bikes at Umbra Electric — 7 curated models, financing and worldwide shipping.
Giant.seoIntro: Giant's electric range here covers full-suspension eMTBs (Trance X E+, Reign E+, Fathom E+, Defy Advanced E+), the Revolt E+ electric gravel bike and the Talon E+ Jr. for young riders. The Trance X E+ is the one most often cross-shopped against Trek Rail and Cannondale Moterra Neo, while the Revolt E+ competes directly with Cannondale Topstone Neo. Financing and worldwide shipping are available across the lineup.

HappyRun.metaDescription: Shop HappyRun electric dirt bikes at Umbra Electric — G300 Pro and SUV E-Bike, price, specs, financing and worldwide shipping.
HappyRun.seoIntro: HappyRun's G300 Pro and SUV E-Bike are built for riders who want serious off-road capability without Sur-Ron pricing. Compare specs, top speed and range across both models here, with financing and worldwide shipping included.

Husqvarna.metaDescription: Shop Husqvarna EE 5 electric dirt bikes at Umbra Electric — kids and youth/adult crossover models, financing and worldwide shipping.
Husqvarna.seoIntro: Husqvarna's EE 5 platform covers both a dedicated kids build and a youth/adult crossover model, sharing DNA with — and frequently cross-shopped against — the KTM SX-E 5 and Freeride E-XC Junior. See specs and pricing on both EE 5 electric dirt bikes here, with financing and worldwide shipping available.

Juiced Bikes.metaDescription: Shop Juiced Bikes electric commuter and fat tire bikes at Umbra Electric — 4 curated models, financing and worldwide shipping.
Juiced Bikes.seoIntro: Juiced Bikes built its name on big-battery range and moped-style power, and the CrossCurrent X, HyperScrambler 2 and RipCurrent S (standard and fat tire) carry that forward — regularly cross-shopped against Rad Power Bikes and Lectric. Compare specs and pricing across the lineup, with financing and worldwide shipping on every order.

KTM.metaDescription: Shop KTM electric dirt bikes at Umbra Electric — Freeride E-XC, E-SM, Junior and SX-E 5, financing and worldwide shipping.
KTM.seoIntro: KTM's electric dirt bike range runs from the flagship Freeride E-XC and E-SM supermoto down to the Freeride E-XC Junior and SX-E 5 for younger riders — the benchmark the Husqvarna EE 5 and GASGAS MC-E 5 are built to match. Compare price, specs and top speed across the full KTM lineup here, with financing and worldwide shipping available.

Kayo.metaDescription: Shop the Kayo eC2i electric dirt bike at Umbra Electric — price, specs, financing and worldwide shipping.
Kayo.seoIntro: Kayo's eC2i is a mid-power electric dirt bike built for trail riders comparing value against SSR Motorsports. Check price, specs and top speed here, with financing and worldwide shipping included.

Lectric.metaDescription: Shop Lectric electric bikes at Umbra Electric — XP 3.0, XP Lite 2.0 and Lectric ONE, financing and worldwide shipping.
Lectric.seoIntro: Lectric built its reputation on affordable, dependable electric bikes, and the XP 3.0 (standard and fat tire), XP Lite 2.0 and Lectric ONE are the models riders cross-shop most against Rad Power Bikes and Aventon. Compare price and specs across the lineup, with financing and worldwide shipping on every order.

Pivot.metaDescription: Shop Pivot Shuttle electric mountain bikes at Umbra Electric — LT and SL models, financing and worldwide shipping.
Pivot.seoIntro: Pivot's Shuttle LT and Shuttle SL are precision-built full-suspension eMTBs aimed at riders comparing Yeti 160E and Santa Cruz Heckler SL. Check specs and travel across both electric mountain bikes here, with financing and worldwide shipping available.

RFN.metaDescription: Shop the RFN Warrior Pro electric dirt bike at Umbra Electric — price, specs, financing and worldwide shipping.
RFN.seoIntro: RFN's Warrior Pro is a value-focused electric dirt bike built for riders who want Sur-Ron-style trail performance at a lower entry price. See specs, top speed and pricing here, with financing and worldwide shipping included.

Rad Power Bikes.metaDescription: Shop Rad Power Bikes electric bikes at Umbra Electric — RadCity, RadRover, RadRunner and RadExpand, financing and worldwide shipping.
Rad Power Bikes.seoIntro: Rad Power Bikes is one of the most recognized names in electric commuting, and the RadCity 5 Plus, RadRover 6 Plus fat tire, RadRunner 3 Plus and RadExpand 5 folding model are the ones most often cross-shopped against Aventon and Lectric. Compare specs and pricing across the range, with financing and worldwide shipping on every order.

Razor.metaDescription: Shop Razor kids electric dirt bikes at Umbra Electric — MX350, MX400, MX500 and MX650, financing and worldwide shipping.
Razor.seoIntro: Razor's MX line — MX350, MX400, MX500 and MX650 — is the most accessible entry point into kids electric dirt bikes, sized and speed-limited by age from 7 and up. Compare specs and age recommendations across all four models here, an easy first step before stepping up to a KTM SX-E 5, with financing and worldwide shipping included.

Ride1Up.metaDescription: Shop Ride1Up electric bikes at Umbra Electric — 7 curated commuter, folding and fat tire models, financing and worldwide shipping.
Ride1Up.seoIntro: Ride1Up covers commuter, folding and fat tire electric bikes with the LMT'D, Prodigy, Prodigy ST, Revv 1, Rift, Turris and Portola Folding — a lineup regularly cross-shopped against Aventon and Rad Power Bikes on price-per-feature. SSR Motorsports.metaDescription: Shop SSR Motorsports electric dirt bikes at Umbra Electric — SR-E15 Pro and SR-E8 Pro, financing and worldwide shipping.
SSR Motorsports.seoIntro: SSR Motorsports' SR-E15 Pro and SR-E8 Pro are built for riders comparing power-per-dollar against Sur-Ron and Kayo. Check specs, top speed and pricing on both electric dirt bikes here, with financing and worldwide shipping included.

Santa Cruz.metaDescription: Shop Santa Cruz electric mountain bikes at Umbra Electric — Bullit and Heckler SL models, financing and worldwide shipping.
Santa Cruz.seoIntro: Santa Cruz's Bullit and Heckler SL are flagship full-suspension eMTBs built for riders who cross-shop Specialized Turbo Levo SL and Yeti 160E and won't compromise on suspension feel. Compare travel, build kit and pricing across the range here, with financing and worldwide shipping available.

Scott.metaDescription: Shop Scott eRIDE electric mountain bikes at Umbra Electric — Patron and Ransom Tuned, financing and worldwide shipping.
Scott.seoIntro: Scott's Patron eRIDE and Ransom eRIDE Tuned are enduro-focused eMTBs built to go head-to-head with Trek Rail and Specialized Turbo Levo on descending capability. See specs and travel across both models here, with financing and worldwide shipping included.

Segway.metaDescription: Shop Segway electric bikes at Umbra Electric — Xaber 300 electric dirt bike, Myon and Muxi folding, financing and worldwide shipping.
Segway.seoIntro: Segway spans two very different rides here: the Xaber 300 electric dirt bike, a genuine Sur-Ron and Talaria alternative in two colorways, and the Myon and Muxi Folding for everyday commuting, cross-shopped against Aventon and Rad Power Bikes. Compare specs and pricing across the lineup, with financing and worldwide shipping available.

Serial 1.metaDescription: Shop Serial 1 electric commuter bikes at Umbra Electric — Mosh/Cty and Rush/Cty models, financing and worldwide shipping.
Serial 1.seoIntro: Serial 1 (born from Harley-Davidson's electric bike program) builds premium electric commuter bikes with real moto-inspired styling — the Rush/Cty and Mosh/Cty are the models most cross-shopped against Trek Allant+ and Specialized Turbo Vado SL. Specialized.metaDescription: Shop Specialized electric bikes at Umbra Electric — Turbo Levo SL, Kenevo SL, Creo SL, Vado SL and Como SL, financing and worldwide shipping.
Specialized.seoIntro: Specialized's Turbo range covers nearly every category we carry: the Turbo Levo SL and Kenevo SL for trail and enduro eMTB riding, the Turbo Creo SL electric road bike, the Turbo Vado SL and Como SL for commuting, and the Riprock Comp e for younger riders. The Turbo Levo SL is the one most often cross-shopped against Santa Cruz Heckler SL and Trek Rail. Compare specs and pricing across the full Specialized lineup, with financing and worldwide shipping available.

Stark Future.metaDescription: Shop the Stark Varg electric enduro motorcycle at Umbra Electric — Standard and Street-Legal EX, financing and worldwide shipping.
Stark Future.seoIntro: Stark Future's Varg is the electric enduro motorcycle that redefined what's possible in the category — fully adjustable power from 10 to 80 hp, race-level performance in both the Standard and street-legal EX builds. Compare specs and pricing on both Varg models here, with financing and worldwide shipping available.

Sur-Ron.metaDescription: Shop Sur-Ron electric dirt bikes at Umbra Electric — Light Bee X, Ultra Bee and Storm Bee, financing and worldwide shipping.
Sur-Ron.seoIntro: Sur-Ron is the electric dirt bike that started the modern lightweight e-moto category, and the Light Bee X, Ultra Bee and flagship Storm Bee remain the reference point every Talaria and Zero Motorcycles alternative is measured against. Compare price, specs and top speed across all three here, with financing and worldwide shipping on every order.

Talaria.metaDescription: Shop Talaria electric dirt bikes at Umbra Electric — Sting MX3, Sting R MX4, MX5 Pro and Komodo, financing and worldwide shipping.
Talaria.seoIntro: Talaria built its name on serious power-per-dollar, and the Sting MX3, Sting R MX4, Sting R MX5 Pro and new Komodo are the electric dirt bikes riders cross-shop most against Sur-Ron and Segway Xaber 300. Compare specs, top speed and pricing across the full Talaria lineup here, with financing and worldwide shipping available.

Tork.metaDescription: Shop the Tork electric dirt bike at Umbra Electric — 72V 16.8kW Base Model, price, specs, financing and worldwide shipping.
Tork.seoIntro: Tork's Base Model runs a 72V 16.8kW powertrain, built for riders comparing raw output against Sur-Ron. Check full specs and pricing here, with financing and worldwide shipping included.

Trek.metaDescription: Shop Trek electric bikes at Umbra Electric — Rail, Powerfly, Domane+, Allant+, Checkpoint+ and Precaliber+, financing and worldwide shipping.

The Rail is the one most cross-shopped against Specialized Turbo Levo SL and Santa Cruz Heckler, while the Domane+ competes directly with Specialized Turbo Creo SL. Compare specs and pricing across the full Trek lineup, with financing and worldwide shipping available.

Woom.metaDescription: Shop Woom UP kids electric bikes at Umbra Electric — UP 5 and UP 6, financing and worldwide shipping.

Compare age and size recommendations against Specialized Riprock Comp e and Trek Precaliber+ here, with financing and worldwide shipping included.

Yeti Cycles.metaDescription: Shop Yeti 160E electric mountain bikes at Umbra Electric — C2, C3 and T2 builds, financing and worldwide shipping.
Yeti Cycles.seoIntro: Yeti Cycles' 160E is a benchmark full-suspension eMTB, available here in C2, C3 and flagship T2 builds — the electric mountain bike riders most often cross-shop against Santa Cruz Heckler SL and Pivot Shuttle LT. Compare build kits and pricing across all three, with financing and worldwide shipping available.

Zero Motorcycles.metaDescription: Shop Zero Motorcycles electric bikes at Umbra Electric — Zero FX, XB and XE, financing and worldwide shipping.
Zero Motorcycles.seoIntro: Zero Motorcycles brings genuine street-motorcycle engineering to the electric dirt bike world with the dual-sport FX, and the more affordable XB and XE round out the range for riders comparing against Sur-Ron on build quality rather than price alone. Compare specs and pricing across all three Zero models here, with financing and worldwide shipping available.
